subheading: TREATMENT OF INTRA-HEPATIC CHOLESTATIC JAUNDICE OF PREGNANCY
subheading_corrected: TREATMENT OF INTRA-HEPATIC CHOLESTATIC JAUNDICE OF PREGNANCY
text:
Treatment
- Careful maternal follow-up with LFTs
- Foetal surveillance: by growth (serial USS biometry) and well-being (CTG) monitoring
- If all is well, induce at 38 weeks
- Management of pruritus
- See cholestasis of pregnancy
Recurrence
- Risk of recurrence is 50%
- Can be precipitated by estrogen-containing oral contraceptive pills
